validity-cost-default.json.method: Disjoint self samples. WASM time deltas include attach/stop boundaries; native seconds distribute observed sampling-run wall time by sample count. These are diagnostic times, not predicted savings. Guest-page grouping assigns WASM inlined callees to the region entry; native blocks have finer boundaries. Do not equate individual entries as identical workloads.

validity-cost-tracked.json.method: Disjoint self samples. WASM time deltas include attach/stop boundaries; native seconds distribute observed sampling-run wall time by sample count. These are diagnostic times, not predicted savings. Guest-page grouping assigns WASM inlined callees to the region entry; native blocks have finer boundaries. Do not equate individual entries as identical workloads.

validity-cost-default-repeat.json.method: Disjoint self samples. WASM time deltas include attach/stop boundaries; native seconds distribute observed sampling-run wall time by sample count. These are diagnostic times, not predicted savings. Guest-page grouping assigns WASM inlined callees to the region entry; native blocks have finer boundaries. Do not equate individual entries as identical workloads.

limitations: Two unprofiled trials per browser variant; substantial shared-host variation, no reliable safe speedup.
1ms native sample run 1 was severely perturbed (15.62s) and is not representative of unprofiled execution; all data retained.
Self-sample categories are disjoint; common phase timings and generated inclusive samples overlap and cannot be summed.
WASM region entry aggregates inlined callees, unlike fine-grained native JIT blocks.
Native PC signal sampling and CDP browser sampling have different overhead/bias; exact cross-backend per-function ratios are not established.
Browser changed from 150 to 153 during system updates. Fresh controls all use 153; older batches are not causal controls.
No second game, mobile hardware, or audio-quality validation.
